headline_en: Clarity before the first shovel hits the ground
headline_so: Hufnaan buuxda kahor intaan dhismuhu bilaaban
quote_en: Adde Design Studio gave us complete architectural drawings alongside a transparent itemized BOQ so we knew exact cement and steel quantities before committing.
quote_so: Adde Design Studio waxay na siiyeen naqshad dhammaystiran iyo BOQ cad oo noo suurtageliyay inaan ogaanno kharashka dhabta ah kahor bilowga.

headline_en: Climate-smart thinking for East African commerce
headline_so: Fikir casri ah oo ku habboon ganacsiga Bariga Afrika
quote_en: Their passive-cooling layout and clear space optimization transformed how our commercial plaza functions structurally and financially.
quote_so: Naqshaddooda hawo-wareegga iyo sida ay u maareeyeen booska ganacsigu waxay sare u qaadday qiimaha dhismaha.
